name: adsterra-ad-monorepo
description: Framework-agnostic ad components with React, Vue, and Svelte adapters.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @adsterra-ad/core && npm run build -w @adsterra-ad/react && npm run build -w @adsterra-ad/vue && npm run build -w @adsterra-ad/svelte
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @adsterra-ad/core && npm run typecheck -w @adsterra-ad/react && npm run typecheck -w @adsterra-ad/vue && npm run typecheck -w @adsterra-ad/svelte
scripts.dev:react:full: npm run build && npm run dev:react
scripts.dev:vue:full: npm run build && npm run dev:vue
scripts.dev:svelte:full: npm run build && npm run dev:svelte
scripts.publish:dry-run: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm publish --access public --dry-run -w @adsterra-ad/core && npm publish --access public --dry-run -w @adsterra-ad/react && npm publish --access public --dry-run -w @adsterra-ad/vue && npm publish --access public --dry-run -w @adsterra-ad/svelte
scripts.publish:all: npm publish --access public -w @adsterra-ad/core && npm publish --access public -w @adsterra-ad/react && npm publish --access public -w @adsterra-ad/vue && npm publish --access public -w @adsterra-ad/svelte
